reviews.text: Very kind vet with same-day appointments. We just visited once for end-of-life care for our dog, and were very impressed with the kindness and professionalism of the staff. The practice also feels less corporate than other vets in the area, and the cost was far more affordable. Wish we’d always taken our dog here, highly recommend.

Brought  my cat in there after an emergency vet visit. The difference was night and day. They actually care about you and your animal. They take the time to discuss treatments and options. They were able to help get my cat Lazarus healthy and running around again. 100% recommend.
Doctors are great, compassionate and kind
We took our cat Leia to see Dr. Szacki for the first time. Dr. Szacki was warm and caring and very attentive to Leia and us. I am so happy to have a new vet for our baby girl!

Really kind staff, my pets have seen several of their vets over the years and they have all been very helpful and always ensure they answer all my questions/address my concerns. When my cat passed away a couple of years ago (at an emergency vet, mind you, not even at their office) they found out and sent me a condolences card, I really appreciated the gesture. It's clear that the folks at Park Slope Veterinary Center care deeply about pets and know how special they are to us. <3
I don’t believe this place has good intentions for the animals. They are money hungry and expensive. Look elsewhere for sufficient care for your animals!!
Very helpful team, quality treatments and everything explained clearly with all the options
Great care for our boy, Picasso. They accommodated a last minute emergency and we are extremely grateful.
Great doctors, very friendly service!

Park slope vet center has been taking care of my German shepherd dog and Bombay mix cat for several years. Hands down the best vet I've had in over 35 years of having fur babies. They do not upsell unnecessary treatments or diagnostics and you can tell every single person in that office loves their work. I recently moved north but still do the obnoxious drive to Brooklyn so that my guys are in their care. 100% recommend.

We love Park Slope Vet Center! We have been taking our cat here for over a year now. The staff are all friendly and welcoming. Dr. Szacki is the best. She is deeply caring and also very practical. And she does so much for the feral and stray cats in our community. It is so nice to have someone we trust look after our boy. ❤️ Highly recommend.

I had a very good first experience with this place. Appointments are easy to schedule, and care is friendly & thorough.  From their receptionists to the vets to the techs, everyone is knowledgeable, loving, and articulate. Dr. Amy Lin was very professional and made sure I left feeling confident by answering questions I  had about my cat.
Pricing is fair & transparent.

I been taking both of my cats here. Honestly best experience ever! The staff is so nice, always break down how much it will be each I appreciate it. One of my cats was a rescue she had tape worms, fleas and the vet did an amazing job. Literally it took out in 2 weeks LESS THAN A MONTH. Now they feel better than ever<3
Thank you to the whole vet team. Thank you for keeping up with Kesh and I all these years. Extremely grateful. Thank you Ann, Dr YS, and Dr JO!
Excellent care and terrific staff

We couldn’t be happier with the care we’ve received at Park Slope Veterinary Center. This is now our second dog with them, and at this point we truly wouldn’t go anywhere else.

The entire team is professional, compassionate, and incredibly attentive—but a special shoutout to Dr. Szacki, who has been absolutely amazing with both of our dogs, Gia and Coco. She takes the time to explain everything clearly, is thoughtful in her approach, and you can tell she genuinely cares about the animals she treats.

It gives us real peace of mind knowing our dogs are in such capable and caring hands. If you’re looking for a vet you can fully trust, this is the place. Highly, highly recommend.

It took me a while to write this but I can’t thank the people at Park Slope Veterinary enough. I adopted my cat last year and while I knew because she was a senior cat she wouldn’t be with me much longer, everyone there treated us with so much care and love. They were always realistic and honest about next steps. When it was time to put my little Gigi down, I waited for Dr.Ozog to be available because I know she would make the transition comfortable for me and Gigi. It was difficult but everyone there was so kind and empathetic. I went to pick up Gigi’s ashes the next week and again was met with such kindness and condolences. When I am ready for a new pet, I will absolutely be bringing them here. I live in Queens now but I have such faith in them that it’s worth the trip.

I have brought my cat here since she was 2yrs old or so, It has been 2yrs since I took my Bb girl whose now 13yo and I was very pleased with the service I received from Dr. Lin, Matthew and Sylvester. I was impressed at how good Mathew and Sylvester handled my Bb while drawing blood and clipping her nails, my Bb was a good girl as if she totally trusted them! Thank you Dr Lin, Mat & Sylvester for being so patient and caring w/my Bb girl.
Love the care and attention we receive here. I recommend this vet to everyone.

This place was a pleasure to visit.  The vets here are knowledgeable, kind, and professional, and very easy to talk to.  I like that they put the patient first, and are not just book smart, but draw on their own experience.  I trust them.

I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Amy Lin. She was incredibly professional and made sure I left feeling confident by answering every single question I had about my doggie. The office is really clean and everybody is really polite and kind.

We love PSVC. They took such incredible care of our beloved dog.
After 16 years of an amazing life, we had to put our dog down. PSVC made us (including our two kids) feel so comfortable, didn’t rush us, and the vet and techs really were just the kindest, sweetest people. We’re eternally grateful to them. Thanks so much for honoring Smokey’s life with us. 🩵

Been coming here since 2012. Dr Szacki has been wonderful to me and my pets all through these years. Recently she cut down her hours and I was unable to obtain an appt with her. The receptionist  suggested Dr Monica Murphy and after seeing her twice I am very happy...she is very pleasant, took her time with me as she suggested a better over the counter food for my renal cat and helped me with a problem re: my cat's B/P medication. Thank You to these marvelous caring veterinarians

Tractor had his first visit and I am so thankful for the service provided.  Staff is top notch!!!  Thank you Dr. Szacki for your great bedside manner with Tractor.  You gave him the care he needed.  We will DEFINITELY return!!!

Dr. Szacki is an absolute pleasure! After being brushed off by many providers at different clinics in the past, I finally have a full picture of my pet's health and action steps to keep her on the right track. My cat is terrified of strangers and historically has fully shut down at the vet. I was amazed to see her relax and cooperate through her full exam at PSVC! Absolutely magical. I felt heard as a pet parent and could tell that the team truly cared about Wendy. So grateful to have found my new partner to help me give her the best life she deserves. 🩷

almost eight years ago I moved to this city from the midwest, and a year later my dog kodiak - who I’d had since he was six months old and I was sixteen - moved here with me. I was petrified I wouldn’t be able to take care of him properly, and between working three jobs and moving apartments constantly, I really worried I wasn’t doing my best.

I was recommended park slope veterinary center by a coworker after a terrible experience with a different vet, and I never looked back. I will forever be thankful for that recommendation.

not only are Dr. Ozog and Dr. Szacki incredible doctors, but they showed me nothing but patience and kindness for the last six years. they were incredibly thorough, while also understanding I was a twenty-something struggling to make it in nyc without a disposable income. they always went above and beyond to make sure not only kodiak was taken care of, but that I’d be okay too. as someone who was eating ramen noodles for every meal, this was monumental. there was never judgement, there was never pressure if I couldn’t afford a blood test - we just worked with what we had and made sure kodiak was okay.

this november we had to make the hardest call in the world and put kodiak down at sixteen. that dog was my entire heart and it was the most difficult thing I’ve ever had to do in my life, but the PSVC team took such excellent care of me, my partner, and kodiak in his final moments. I cannot express enough the love and care they showed us and continue to show us. they have really made such an impossible situation as painless as they could and i hope each and every person there reads this and knows that you helped me through one of the darkest moments of my life.

I was missing kodiak a lot yesterday, so imagine my surprise when I grabbed the mail to find this handwritten card. Thank you. Thank you so, so, so much for taking care of my boy. He loved you all. He hated the vet, as most animals do, but he LOVED you guys. I cannot thank you enough.

And if you’re looking through reviews to see if you should take your pets here: emphatically yes.
Have been going here for years with Dr. Ozog and have had great experiences. I appreciate that they're very upfront about costs etc. My kitty loves her and I am happy to have found a great vet

Owning a pet is a big responsibility and should not be taken lightly. it is also expensive. Visits to the veterinarian are needed and have a high cost.
This veterinarian office is very comprehensive, and they understand what your pet means to you. Doctors are very good and in case the pet needs more deep care, they provide good places for urgent care and they follow up.
They are very busy and everyone there trust their pets with them.

Never go back again robbery you don't even see your animal what they doing to your animal they take your Island went to the back and charge you a big bill never again going back very bad customer service too

Nice staff and assistants and Vets. Be aware of upsell tactics. Could be necessary but sometimes not really. $45 non negotiable fee for first time patients to reserve a visit time. (Included with Vet visit)

Prior to the appointment I was told they specialize in a specific ailment my pet was going through. Instead of any care, I was taken to a side room with a “veterinarian” named Amy Lin & she wants to put him down and the most disturbing & disgusting "Sorry for you’re loss" with my pet still alive. I asked about the medication for the ailment and she literally googled in front of me. She had no idea what she was doing and ESPECIALLY not as the specialist they claimed to be in. Literally googling the condition they “specialize in” - a JOKE. This was a complete scam from this clinic & the refused to refund after the owner admitting the vet was poor I was given too!!!

Went to another vet & guess what - he needed a higher dose on the medication he’s on.

Makes me sick to see veterinarian malpractice in action & the thought of what poor pets have passed due to the incompetence at this clinic.

I've NEVER seen such unprofessionalism and lack of care from any clinic - EVER. DO NOT COME HERE THEY WANT TO KILL YOUR PET.

*** Adding to owners response - that is a lie. I had to tell you to leave me alone as you were chasing me out the door on the side walk apologizing for how Amy Lin handled the appointment & suddenly they acted like they cared about helping my pet. Video tapes have it all recorderd. And no you did not "kick me out" you ran me to the register to pay & REFUSE TO REFUND. Another reason DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE.

So I went in to get my tuxedo short hair checked out I informed the intake nurse of my concerns about costs. I got the idea to do so from a sign in the waiting area that suggests to inform the staff of any financial concerns. I also informed the doctor. Dr did an ultrasound and informed me of the costs and asked if it’s ok and I confirmed that it was. After the ultrasound I was brought to the painful conclusion that I’d have to put my cat to sleep. I again told the doctor of my concerns regarding costs and she told me not to worry and there is a payment plan. She didn’t get into specifics. I asked her “are you sure? Because the receptionist at the front desk said that you guys don’t do payment plans?” She made a face and said “yes they do over the course of six months” I paid my balance for the visit and ultrasound and left. I came back later in the evening with my teenage daughter and my co parent. The procedure was explained to us. It was really hard for us. Even typing this is really hard for me. But I can’t just not say anything. We were able to watch Dr push the medication for Kitty Love to be put to sleep but nothing more. It was too much to bare. Dr said I was good to go, hugged me and the receptionist Erica reminded me that I had to check out. She told me “it’s $496 today” (including a paw print, I could have done without it but my daughter really wanted it) I explained to the receptionist the conversation I had with Dr and staff and she said “we don’t do payment plans” I said reiterated what Dr told me and also told her Dr did not tell me it was going to be $496 up front. She said “one moment” and then came back and said “ Dr said she spoke to you this morning and said she did tell you the cost”. I was baffled because no she did not and she told me that assured me that payment plan was in fact an option. The reception said again “we don’t do payment plans”. I explained that she did say that a payment plan over the course of six months was an option. So then the receptionist goes “yeah that’s CareCredit”. I said “care what? Excuse me?”. Erica reiterated and then said with hand gestures and all included “YOU HAVE TO APPLY FOR THE CARE CREDIT TO PAY THIS BALANCE OF 496.00 TODAY!” then she said “sorry I’m just the middle man. The lady behind me made a face as to say “whoa” Erica was super loud and I was so embarrassed. I explained that I could have it by the following week (next paycheck) but to no avail. This diagnosis was unexpected I thought my cat caught a bug and we were just going to get meds and go home ($200 tops) I had no idea it was going to end like this. Well my coparent ended up stepping in to put the expenses on his credit card. She said “It went through, sorry for your loss.” I know this is a business and you must see plenty of animals walk in and get unexpected diagnosis and outcomes everyday but I must say the way I was treated was horrible and I wish I would’ve received some grace. I felt awful. 🤢  Erica was ridiculously nasty to make it worse and perhaps Dr didn’t know but to tell the receptionist that she told me if the costs for this evening is not true. I understand she sees many patients maybe she forgot idk I want to give her the benefit of the doubt and at the same time I’m so overwhelmed with embarrassment and grief. Just can’t believe it. Please excuse any typos.

They are the best of the best. My cats have been patients for years and they have also seen multiple of my rescues and fosters. From their receptionists to the vets to the techs, everyone is knowledgeable, loving and articulate, they know what they are doing and they do it to the highest of standards. I am moving away and I am sad to leave them, I recently asked for my vet records and I got them immediately. Even when they know they are losing your business, the PSVC people come through, which shows they truly care.
They the best ❤️

We have been bringing our large dog and our kitty to Park Slope Veterinary Center for years and have always had really great experiences. The doctors are all caring and knowledgeable, and really take the time to listen to fur parents about whatever issues we have. The office staff and the techs are also really great - our dog pulls hard to get into the vet's office, which is saying something! Highly recommend this practice!

Dr Ozog is professional, incredibly knowledgeable, and I feel very confident in the care she provides. When my first cat was diagnosed with cancer, she offered several options for care and was honest about my cat's condition. It was clear that Park Slope Vet Center put my cat's quality of life first and I wholeheartedly trusted their guidance.

Dr. Ozog actually saved my next cat (which we are eternally grateful to her for!), so she is essentially my cat's godmother and we look forward to visiting her once year.

I highly recommend Park Slope Vet Center for your pet! They are the best of the best!
Excellent first visit. Time was taken to review all my questions and concerns. Explained everything in detail.
Excellent experience. Right on time and a quick pick up later. Supportive tech and vet who understand how to work with semi-feral cats.

Overall, it was an excellent experience with very reasonable prices. I was given an appointment right away, and from the moment I walked in with my little Bengie, every staff member was warm and welcoming and that made him feel very safe .
I would highly recommend them ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Thank you so much for the wonderful service! 🌸
It's a very good clinic, the staff are always very friendly and give you a good explanation about your pet. The place is very clean and they treat your animals like they're part of the family.
This is the only place that could handle my cat. Great care was shown to her throughout several health conditions.

I just called this clinic to try and get some answers for an emergency my cat is going through. The woman who answered the phone, I believe a Monique or Monica something that starts with a “M” was pretty rude.
This is a tough time and I’m low income so I’m just calling around to price check & see what would be the best option for my cat to receive care and this is the only place that I’ve called that treated me horribly. I expressed that I’ve called all the low income clinics that I can, so I’m just calling around for prices on appointments and possible treatments. She very impolitely told me this is not a low income clinic (which I knew) She had a bad tone with me & hung up the phone.

People should not treated this way. I called on 07/09/2025 @ 3:51pm
Really nice vets and staff!  Clean and professional!  Great with my dog who is super nervous with vets and also pretty big.  They clearly break down costs and what is needed.  Highly recommended!

I found this vet with a TNR that needed immediate care. The front desk staff is amazing and Dr. Ozog couldn’t be any better, she’s knowledgeable, gently, compassionate and just and all around amazing veterinarian! We have made this our perm vet for our girl and will continue to go back. Thank you guys always for taking care of our babies!

My cat has been seeing Dr. Ozog for the majority of his life and we would never take him anywhere else! Dr Ozog is absolutely amazing at assessing our very wiggly cat and is really good at accurately diagnosing him even though he has some uncommon medical conditions (especially for his young age). She is really kind and very, very thorough with her explanations. When we first got the asthma diagnosis, she went out of her way to give us multiple suggestions on where we could get meds/inhalers at the best price. Couldn't have asked for a better vet as first time pet owners!

We have had an amazing experience with the entire practice in general. The team at the front is always super responsive and helpful. They are lightning fast if you need to have your pets medical records sent to the ER.

We don't see Dr. Szacki or the other doctors very much, but when we do - those have been great experiences as well. All the doctors here are really considerate and non-judgemental when it's time to talk about budget and treatment options. In general, their pricing across the board is really affordable and reasonable (especially when compared to what other vets in Brooklyn have been charging us).

Park Slope is also very punctual with all their appointments, which is really important to me since I have a strict work schedule.

Would absolutely recommend Park Slope to anyone in need of a good and trustworthy vet!!

I’ve been bringing my cats to this vet for a few years now. Dr Ozog has a great bedside manner and is very knowledgeable. I would recommend this facility to anyone in the area who is looking for a quality and trustworthy vet.
Love this place & staff! I feel safe every time I bring my Cat 🐈❤️ …

I have been with Dr. Szacky for 12 years and she is the most wonderful and dedicated vet. She genuinely cares about animals and even helps the rescue community. Her staff is very nice and helpfull. Thankfully Dr. Szacky diagnosed and gave excellent referrals when my cats needed specialty treatment and I am sure they are as fit as they are thanks to her thoroughness.  I wouldn't go to any other vet!

Dr. Ozog is the best! She was so sweet and attentive to my dog’s needs. She was thorough and very considerate of expenses. I can’t recommend her enough. The facility is also well kept and the staff is friendly!
The most trustworthy and competent vet in NYC.
🥹great people and great care. definitely coming back!! …

A couple of Fridays ago , l took our new dog to Park Slope veterinary for her first time. Everyone was so friendly and they took great care of our new addition. I trust this clinic, since they also cared for my old dog “ Brody” . They are true professionals and l would highly recommend.
They were great ! Timely, kind, considerate, and gave me my options without trying to charge me for anything extra . My kitty was as comfy as was possible
I love Dr Szacki and Ozog - they keep my kitties happy and healthy. Highly recommend this vet clinic!!

They wrote the kindest letter in a card they mailed to our address when they learned that our kitty Otis had died. He had cancer and the emergency clinic we had to take him to when he stopped breathing must have notified them. I can’t express how meaningful that gesture was, for anyone considering taking their pet into their care.

I took my cats here when they were kittens. They were chipped without authorization. It wasn't cheap. But when one went missing, I found that it was only for identification services. Not tracking. And there's a yearly charge for the service.

They cut open my animal just to charge me more money. I'll never go back to this place.

I love Park Slope Vet Center. They have cared for a few of my cats over the years. They are compassionate and supportive. Always giving good advice without judgement or trying to sell you services. When our last cat was at the end of her …
Excellent service

On July 20th I found 4 abandon kittens and when all places turned me down when I was seeking medical attention. Parkslope didn't the staff was very friendly and welcoming took time to help, they was really patient and understanding they …

My recent yearly vist to Park Slope Veteri are Center was once again great. I was seen on time.  My dog was treated with kindness and warmth by all the staff. Dr.Ozog listened to all my concerns and answered all my questions. I highly recommend their services.
They provided end of life care to my cat a few months ago and were patient and helpful during difficult decision process.
My dog actually likes coming here. She pulls me to the door when we’re just going on walks.  That says a lot. Friendly and efficient staff. Have been coming here for over 9 years.
